correctness.rationale: Exact sparse-polynomial replay verifies rational Segre parametrizations of both printed quadrics and exact factorizations of the quartic restrictions into degree-four bidegree (1,3) and (3,1) factors. The source independently proves those sections have exactly two smooth irreducible rational quartic components, proves geometric Picard number 3 for the exact surface, identifies its full Néron–Severi lattice as S2, and proves there are exactly six (-2)-curves. Therefore the four Q-defined curve classes and H generate the full geometric Néron–Severi group, so Galois acts trivially. Uniqueness of an effective irreducible representative in a (-2)-class descends the last two curves; uniqueness of the quadric containing a smooth rational quartic descends Q3. No finite experiment is used as an infinite or geometric exhaustion proof.
